sol2f.gui.config.title: Spice of Life: Fabric Flavor Settings
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.Increas: Frequency of extra health rewards. Set to 0 to disable special rewards. (Combine with healthyGain=0 to enable multi-eat progression). Range: 0–20
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.frequen: Amount of max health increased per frequency threshold. Range: 2–30
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthy: Max health gained per new food type. Range: 0–20
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.resetOn: If enabled, player's max health resets to default on death.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthT: Refill current health to maximum whenever max health increases.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.healthI: Additional health restored when max health increases (in half-hearts). Recommended: even number.
sol2f.gui.config.option.features.Express: Custom health calculation expression. Set to '0' to disable.
Tip: To use only this expression, set 'Health Gain per New Food' and 'Special Reward Frequency' to 0.
If enabled, this expression works alongside the simple health gain settings (they are not mutually exclusive).
- uniqueFoods: number of unique foods eaten
